bullets.text: Infostealers Targeting macOS - **Microsoft Defender** identifies rising threats targeting macOS with credential-stealing malware.
Securing AI Supply Chains - **Microsoft** emphasizes the importance of securing AI frameworks to prevent exploitation.
AI-Driven Threat Detection - **Microsoft** introduces AI-assisted workflows to enhance threat detection and analysis.
Data Security Index Insights - **Microsoft** reveals critical priorities for securing AI adoption in the latest Data Security Index report.
Windows 11 Insider Updates - New builds released for **Windows 11** Insiders include various feature enhancements and fixes.
Celebrating Security Excellence - **Microsoft** honors partners at the 2026 Security Excellence Awards for outstanding cybersecurity contributions.
